execution.trigger: The require statement inside the loop without any guards against insufficient funds.
execution.state_issue: No check for whether an address has funds before attempting to send them.
execution.exploitable_behavior: Even if one address can't send, all other addresses' funds are processed incorrectly.

causality.state: Presence of addresses with zero funds
causality.transition: Execution flow allows the require to fail immediately
causality.capability: Attackers can exploit this to cause a DoS
causality.outcome: Failure in sending funds or exception being thrown
